description: This is a PHP source file defining the TaxRate class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation namespace. The class provides methods to manage tax rates, including creating, updating, deleting, and querying tax rate data. It interacts with a database and is part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform's administrative backend.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Represents the tax rate entity, providing methods for CRUD operations and related data management within the localisation module.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Adds a new tax rate to the database and optionally associates customer groups.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Updates an existing tax rate identified by its ID, and manages associated customer groups.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Deletes a tax rate by its ID, including related customer group associations.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific tax rate, including its geo zone.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Fetches a list of tax rates, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRates
methods.description: Returns the total number of tax rates in the database.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Returns the count of tax rates associated with a specific geo zone.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a tax rate with a customer group.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes all customer group associations for a specific tax rate.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroupsByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Deletes all tax rate associations for a specific customer group.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves customer groups associated with a particular tax rate.
